in_marathi.name: Vasudhaiva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasudhaiva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vasudhaiva is a Sanskrit name derived from the phrase ‘Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam’ which translates to ‘the whole world is one family’. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vasu’ which means ‘dwells’ and ‘daiva’ which means ‘god’. Vasudhaiva is a name for the Lord of the universe and is associated with the idea of inclusiveness and compassion towards all beings.
